# Row Bind Like File Types


```{r}
TR_J1 <- plyr::rbind.fill(utcTR_J1, uthscTR_J1, utkTR_J1) |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests')
TR_J3 <- plyr::rbind.fill(utcTR_J3, uthscTR_J3, utkTR_J3) |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests')
TR_J4 <- plyr::rbind.fill(utcTR_J4, uthscTR_J4, utkTR_J4) |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests')
```





# Import the Journal List and Journal Information from OUP's Website


## All Title List


```{r}
allList <- read_excel('Sage Premier Package Journal List.xlsx') |>
  mutate(isPremier = 'Yes')

allList
```



## STM Package Title List


```{r}
stmList <- read_excel('Sage STM Package Journal List.xlsx') |>
  mutate(isSTM = 'Yes') |>
  select(`Journal Code`, isSTM)

stmList
```


## HSS Package Title List


```{r}
hssList <- read_excel('Sage HSS Package Journal List.xlsx') |>
  mutate(isHSS = 'Yes') |>
  select(`Journal Code`, isHSS)

hssList
```



## Health Science Package Title List


```{r}
healthScienceList <- read_excel('Sage Health Science Package Journal List.xlsx') |>
  mutate(isHealthScience = 'Yes') |>
  select(`Journal Code`, isHealthScience)

healthScienceList
```



## Clinical Medicine Package Title List


```{r}
clinMedList <- read_excel('Sage Clinical Medicine Package Journal List.xlsx') |>
  mutate(isClinMed = 'Yes') |>
  select(`Journal Code`, isClinMed)

clinMedList
```




```{r}
testA <- left_join(allList, stmList, by = 'Journal Code')
testB <- left_join(testA, hssList, by = 'Journal Code')
testC <- left_join(testB, healthScienceList, by = 'Journal Code')
fullPackageList <- left_join(testC, clinMedList, by = 'Journal Code')
```



## Load in the Price List


```{r, warning = FALSE}
priceList <- read_excel('Sage Journal Pricing List.xlsx')

priceList
```



## Clean Up the Price List


```{r}
cleanPriceList <- priceList |>
  filter(`Product Description` %in% c('Electronic Only', 'Electronic + Backfile Lease')) |>
  mutate(`Journal Code` = `SAGE ID Code`)

cleanPriceList
```

# Get Each Title Down to One Row


```{r}
singleRowCost <- data.frame()

ids <- unique(cleanPriceList$`SAGE ID Code`)

for(i in 1:length(ids)){
  uniqueTitle <- cleanPriceList |>
    filter(`SAGE ID Code` == ids[i])
  
  if(dim(uniqueTitle)[1] == 1){
    singleRowCost <- rbind(singleRowCost, uniqueTitle)
  }
  else{
    # Specifically choose the backfile
    backfile <- uniqueTitle |>
      filter(`Product Description` == 'Electronic + Backfile Lease')
    
    singleRowCost <- rbind(singleRowCost, backfile)
  }
}

singleRowCost
```




## Split the Multiple ISSN Cells into Individual Rows

```{r}
separateRowCost <- singleRowCost |>
  mutate(splitISSN = str_split(`E-ISSN`, ', ')) |>
  unnest(cols = c(splitISSN)) |>
  mutate(splitISSN = str_split(splitISSN, ',')) |>
  unnest(cols = c(splitISSN)) |>
  mutate(splitISSN = str_trim(splitISSN, side = 'both'))

separateRowCost
```

```{r}
    .default = Price
  )) |>
  mutate(usage22 = `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022` + `Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022`,
         usage23 = `Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023` + `Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023`,
         usage24 = `Jan-2024` + `Feb-2024` + `Mar-2024` + `Apr-2024` + `May-2024` + `Jun-2024` + `Jul-2024` + `Aug-2024` + `Sep-2024` + `Oct-2024` + `Nov-2024` + `Dec-2024`,
         usage25 = `Jan-2025` + `Feb-2025` + `Mar-2025` + `Apr-2025` + `May-2025` + `Jun-2025`) |>
  mutate(Total_Usage = usage22 + usage23 + usage24 + usage25) |>
  mutate(isCC22 = ifelse((YOP >= 2018 & YOP <= 2022) | YOP == 9999, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isCC23 = ifelse((YOP >= 2019 & YOP <= 2023) | YOP == 9999, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isCC24 = ifelse((YOP >= 2020 & YOP <= 2024) | YOP == 9999, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isCC25 = ifelse(YOP >= 2021, 'Yes', 'No')) |>
  mutate(isBackfile22 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2018, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isBackfile23 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2019, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isBackfile24 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2020, 'Yes', 'No'),
         isBackfile25 = ifelse(YOP > 1997 & YOP < 2021, 'Yes', 'No')) |>
  mutate(isTrueBackfile = ifelse(YOP <= 1997, 'Yes', 'No')) |>
  mutate(currentYearUsage = case_when(
    YOP == 2022 ~ usage22,
    YOP == 2023 ~ usage23,
    YOP == 2024 ~ usage24,
    YOP == 2025 ~ usage25,
    .default = 0),
         ccClearanceUsage = case_when(
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'No' & isCC25 == 'No' ~ usage22,
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'No' & isCC25 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23,
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'Yes' & isCC25 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24,
           isCC22 == 'Yes' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'Yes' & isCC25 == 'Yes' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24 + usage25,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'Yes' & isCC24 == 'Yes' & isCC25 == 'Yes' ~ usage23 + usage24 + usage25,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'Yes' & isCC25 == 'Yes' ~ usage24 + usage25,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'No' & isCC25 == 'Yes' ~ usage25,
           isCC22 == 'No' & isCC23 == 'No' & isCC24 == 'No' & isCC25 == 'No' ~ 0,
           .default = NA
         ),
        backfileUsage = case_when(
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'No' & isBackfile25 == 'No' ~ usage22,
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'No' & isBackfile25 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23,
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' & isBackfile25 == 'No' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24,
           isBackfile22 == 'Yes' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' & isBackfile25 == 'Yes' ~ usage22 + usage23 + usage24 + usage25,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'Yes' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' & isBackfile25 == 'Yes' ~ usage23 + usage24 + usage25,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'Yes' & isBackfile25 == 'Yes' ~ usage24 + usage25,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'No' & isBackfile25 == 'Yes' ~ usage25,
           isBackfile22 == 'No' & isBackfile23 == 'No' & isBackfile24 == 'No' & isBackfile25 == 'No' ~ 0,
           .default = NA          
        ),
        trueBackFileUsage = ifelse(isTrueBackfile == 'Yes', Total_Usage, 0)
  )

TR_J4_Complete |>
  arrange(desc(ccClearanceUsage))
```

```{r}
  )) |>
  mutate(usage22 = `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022` + `Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022`,
         usage23 = `Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023` + `Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023`,

         usage25 = `Jan-2025` + `Feb-2025` + `Mar-2025` + `Apr-2025` + `May-2025` + `Jun-2025`) |>
  mutate(Total_Usage = usage22 + usage23 + usage24 + usage25) |>
  mutate(fullCollectionUsage = ifelse(Collections != "", Total_Usage, 0),
         clinMedCollectionUsage = ifelse(grepl('Clinical Med', Collections, fixed = FALSE) == TRUE, Total_Usage, 0),
         stmCollectionUsage = ifelse(grepl('STM', Collections, fixed = FALSE) == TRUE, Total_Usage, 0),
         hssCollectionUsage = ifelse(grepl('HSS', Collections, fixed = FALSE) == TRUE, Total_Usage, 0),
         stmCollectionUsage = ifelse(grepl('STM', Collections, fixed = FALSE) == TRUE, Total_Usage, 0),
         oaCollectionUsage = ifelse(grepl('Open Access', Collections, fixed = FALSE) == TRUE, Total_Usage, 0),
         unknownCollectionUsage = ifelse(Collections == '', Total_Usage, 0)) |>
  mutate(costUse = Price / (Total_Usage / 3.5))|>
  mutate(costUseBucket = case_when(
    Collections == 'Open Access' ~ 'Full Open Access',
    costUse < 20 ~ 'Under $20',
    costUse >= 20 ~ 'Over $20'
  )
)
```

# Add the Cost/Use Bucket and the Price from TR_Complete to TR_J4_Complete



```{r, warning = FALSE}
smallTRComplete <- TR_J1_Complete |>
  select(Title.x, Location, Collections, costUseBucket, Price)

TR_J4_Export <- left_join(TR_J4_Complete, smallTRComplete, by = c('Title.x' = 'Title.x', 'Location' = 'Location', 'Collections' = 'Collections', 'Price' = 'Price'))
```


# Create the Copyright Clearance Bucket Column


```{r}
TR_J4_Buckets <- TR_J4_Export |>
  group_by(Title.x, Location, Collections, Price) |>
  summarise(copyrightClearanceUsage = sum(ccClearanceUsage)) |>
  mutate(ccCostUse = Price / (copyrightClearanceUsage / 3.5)) |>
  mutate(ccCostUseBucket = case_when(
    Collections == 'Open Access' ~ 'Full Open Access',
    ccCostUse < 20 ~ 'Under $20',
    ccCostUse >= 20 ~ 'Over $20'
  )) |>
  mutate(ccCostUse = ifelse(is.infinite(ccCostUse) == TRUE, 0, ccCostUse)) |>
  mutate(Collections = str_trim(Collections, side = 'both'))
```

```{r}
TR_J4_Export_Final <- left_join(TR_J4_Export, TR_J4_Buckets, by = c('Title.x' = 'Title.x', 'Location' = 'Location', 'Collections' = 'Collections', 'Price' = 'Price')) 
```


# Export the Data

```{r}
write.csv(TR_J4_Export_Final, 'Sage Usage by Year of Publishing.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```

# Mary Ann Liebert Usage Clean-Up


## Load the TR_J1 Files


```{r}
ma1UTK <- read_tsv('Liebert-TRJ1-Jan2022-Jun2025.tsv', skip = 9) |>
  mutate(Location = 'UT Knoxville') |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests')

  mutate(Location = 'Health Science') |>
  filter(Metric_Type == 'Unique_Item_Requests')

colnames(ma1UTHSC) <- c('Title', 'Publisher', 'Publisher_ID', 'Platform', 'DOI', 'Proprietary_ID', 'Print_ISSN', 'Online_ISSN', 'URI', 'Metric_Type', 'Reporting_Period_Total',
                        '2022-01', '2022-02', '2022-03', '2022-04', '2022-05', '2022-06', '2022-07', '2022-08', '2022-09', '2022-10', '2022-11', '2022-12',
```

## Add Collections

```{r}
paidCollections <- ma1 |>
  mutate(Collections = case_when(
    Title %in% c('3D Printing and Additive Manufacturing', 'Big Data', 'New Space', 'Soft Robotics') ~ 'Technology & Engineering',
    
    Title %in% c('AI in Neuroscience', 'AI in Precision Oncology', 'Bariatric Surgical Practice and Patient Care', 'Breastfeeding Medicine', 'Dermatitis®', 'Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics', 'Facial Plastic Surgery & Aesthetic Medicine', 'Games for Health Journal', 'Integrative and Complementary Therapies', 'Journal of Adolescent and Young Adult Oncology', 'Journal of Child and Adolescent Psychopharmacology', 'Journal of Endourology', 'Journal of Gynecologic Surgery', 'Journal of Integrative and Complementary Medicine', 'Journal of Laparoendoscopic and Videoscopy', 'Journal of Palliative Medicine', "Journal of Women's Health", 'Medical Acupuncture', 'Metabolic Syndrome and Related Disorders', 'Pediatric Allergy, Immunology, and Pulmonology', 'Photobiomodulation, Photomedicine, and Laser Surgery', 'Respiratory Care', 'Surgical Infections', 'Therapeutic Hypothermia and Temperature Management', 'Thyroid®', 'Clinical Thyroidology®') ~ 'Clinical Medicine',
    
    Title %in% c('AIDS Patient Care and STDs', 'AIDS Research and Human Retroviruses', 'Applied Biosafety', 'Autism in Adulthood', 'Childhood Obesity', 'Cyberpsychology, Behavior, and Social Networking', 'Ecopsychology', 'Election Law Journal: Rules, Politics, and Policy', 'Environmental Engineering Science', 'Environmental Justice', 'Foodborne Pathogens and Disease', 'Gaming Law Review', 'Health Security', 'Journal of Correctional Health Care', 'LGBT Health', 'Population Health Management', 'Planned Giving Today', 'Sustainability and Climate Change', 'Telemedicine and e-Health', 'Transgender Health', 'Violence and Gender') ~ 'Public Health & Policy',
    
    Title %in% c('Advances in Wound Care', 'Antioxidants & Redox Signaling', 'Applied In Vitro Toxicology', 'ASSAY and Drug Development Technologies', 'Astrobiology', 'Bioelectricity', 'Biopreservation and Biobanking', 'Biotechnology Law Report', 'Brain Connectivity', 'Cancer Biotherapy and Radiopharmaceuticals', 'Cannabis and Cannabinoid Research', 'Cellular Reprogramming', 'DNA and Cell Biology', 'Forensic Genomics', 'GEN Biotechnology', 'GEN Edge', 'Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology News', 'Genetic Testing and Molecular Biomarkers', 'High Altitude Medicine & Biology', 'Human Gene Therapy', 'Industrial Biotechnology', 'Inside Precision Medicine', 'Journal of Aerosol Medicine and Pulmonary Drug Delivery', 'Journal of Computational Biology', 'Journal of Interferon & Cytokine Research', 'Journal of Medicinal Food', 'Journal of Neurotrauma', 'Journal of Ocular Pharmacology and Therapeutics', 'Lymphatic Research and Biology', 'Microbial Drug Resistance', 'Monoclonal Antibodies in Immunodiagnosis and Immunotherapy', 'Nucleic Acid Therapeutics', 'OMICS: A Journal of Integrative Biology', 'PHAGE', 'Psychedlic Medicine', 'Rejuvenation Research', 'Stem Cells and Development', 'The CRISPR Journal', 'Tissue Engineering Part A', 'Tissue Engineering Part B: Reviews', 'Tissue Engineering Part C: Methods', 'Vector-Borne and Zoonotic Diseases', 'Viral Immunology', 'Zebrafish') ~ 'Biotechnology & Life Sciences',
    
    .default = 'Unknown'
  ))

```


# Load in the Cost Files


## UTK from Alma


```{r}
utkCost <- read_excel('Mary Ann Liebert Cost per Title UTK.xlsx') |>
  select(Title, ISSN, `Transaction Amount`) |>
  mutate(Location = 'UT Knoxville')
```


### Split up the ISSN Column

```{r}
splitUTKCost <- utkCost |>
  separate_longer_delim(c(ISSN), delim = ';')

splitUTKCost
```



## Add in UTHSC Cost

```{r}
uthscCost <- data.frame(
  Title = c('Journal of Palliative Medicine'),
  ISSN = c('1557-7740'),
  `Transaction Amount` = c(3191.00),
  Location = c('Health Science')
)

colnames(uthscCost) <- c('Title', 'ISSN', 'Transaction Amount', 'Location')

fullCost <- rbind(splitUTKCost, uthscCost)
```


## Join Cost to the Usage


```{r}
costUsage <- left_join(paidCollections, fullCost, by = c('Online_ISSN' = 'ISSN', 'Location' = 'Location'))

costUsage
```




# Create the Usage File for Export



```{r}
TR_J1_MAL <- costUsage |>
  group_by(Title.x, Location, `Transaction Amount`, Collections) |>
  summarise(`Jan-2022` = sum(`2022-01`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feb-2022` = sum(`2022-02`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mar-2022` = sum(`2022-03`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Apr-2022` = sum(`2022-04`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `May-2022` = sum(`2022-05`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jun-2022` = sum(`2022-06`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jul-2022` = sum(`2022-07`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Aug-2022` = sum(`2022-08`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sep-2022` = sum(`2022-09`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Oct-2022` = sum(`2022-10`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Nov-2022` = sum(`2022-11`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Dec-2022` = sum(`2022-12`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jan-2023` = sum(`2023-01`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feb-2023` = sum(`2023-02`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mar-2023` = sum(`2023-03`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Apr-2023` = sum(`2023-04`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `May-2023` = sum(`2023-05`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jun-2023` = sum(`2023-06`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jul-2023` = sum(`2023-07`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Aug-2023` = sum(`2023-08`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sep-2023` = sum(`2023-09`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Oct-2023` = sum(`2023-10`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Nov-2023` = sum(`2023-11`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Dec-2023` = sum(`2023-12`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jan-2024` = sum(`2024-01`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feb-2024` = sum(`2024-02`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mar-2024` = sum(`2024-03`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Apr-2024` = sum(`2024-04`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `May-2024` = sum(`2024-05`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jun-2024` = sum(`2024-06`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jul-2024` = sum(`2024-07`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Aug-2024` = sum(`2024-08`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sep-2024` = sum(`2024-09`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Oct-2024` = sum(`2024-10`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Nov-2024` = sum(`2024-11`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Dec-2024` = sum(`2024-12`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jan-2025` = sum(`2025-01`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Feb-2025` = sum(`2025-02`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mar-2025` = sum(`2025-03`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Apr-2025` = sum(`2025-04`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `May-2025` = sum(`2025-05`, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jun-2025` = sum(`2025-06`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cost = sum(`Transaction Amount`, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(usage22 = `Jan-2022` + `Feb-2022` + `Mar-2022` + `Apr-2022` + `May-2022` + `Jun-2022` + `Jul-2022` + `Aug-2022` + `Sep-2022` + `Oct-2022` + `Nov-2022` + `Dec-2022`,
         usage23 = `Jan-2023` + `Feb-2023` + `Mar-2023` + `Apr-2023` + `May-2023` + `Jun-2023` + `Jul-2023` + `Aug-2023` + `Sep-2023` + `Oct-2023` + `Nov-2023` + `Dec-2023`,
         usage24 = `Jan-2024` + `Feb-2024` + `Mar-2024` + `Apr-2024` + `May-2024` + `Jun-2024` + `Jul-2024` + `Aug-2024` + `Sep-2024` + `Oct-2024` + `Nov-2024` + `Dec-2024`,
         usage25 = `Jan-2025` + `Feb-2025` + `Mar-2025` + `Apr-2025` + `May-2025` + `Jun-2025`) |>
  mutate(Total_Usage = usage22 + usage23 + usage24 + usage25) |>
  mutate(costUse = as.numeric(Cost / (Total_Usage / 3.5))) |>
  mutate(costUseBucket = case_when(
    Collections == 'Open Access' ~ 'Full Open Access',
    costUse == 0 ~ 'Cost Unknown',
    costUse < 20 & costUse != 0 ~ 'Under $20',
    costUse >= 20 ~ 'Over $20',
  ))
  

TR_J1_MAL
```



```{r}
TR_Complete_Longer_MAL <- TR_J1_MAL |>
  pivot_longer(cols = contains('-'),
               names_to = 'Month',
               values_to = 'Usage') |>
  mutate(Collections = str_trim(Collections, side = 'both'))

write.csv(TR_Complete_Longer_MAL, 'Mary Ann Liebert Cost Per Use.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
